top_signals.title: Ukraine disputes Elon Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms during drone operations
top_signals.summary: Ukraine challenged Musk’s claim that its military violated Starlink terms, arguing that commercial Starlink limits prevented medium- and long-range strike use.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
